description:
Cross-platform desktop application for translation based on ChatGPT API.


LiteLLM provider, Markdown tables, and a Linux tray fix
- Added LiteLLM as a built-in AI gateway provider
- Markdown tables (GFM) in translation results now render as real tables instead of raw text
- Fixed the Quit action missing from the tray menu on Linux
- Fixed the Tauri Vite build on Windows
